exceptions.name: @img/sharp-libvips-darwin-arm64
exceptions.why: Image library binary pulled in by miniflare (Workers test pool and wrangler) for local runs only; never bundled into a Worker or the app.

exceptions.name: @img/sharp-libvips-darwin-x64
exceptions.why: Intel build of the image library binary pulled in by miniflare (Workers test pool and wrangler) for local runs only, installed on Intel Macs; never bundled into a Worker or the app.

exceptions.name: lightningcss-darwin-x64
exceptions.why: Intel build of lightningcss, installed on Intel Macs, same use as its darwin-arm64 twin.

exceptions.name: lightningcss
exceptions.why: CSS tool pulled in by vite (under vitest) at build and test time; its code is not shipped, only its output.

exceptions.name: lightningcss-darwin-arm64
exceptions.why: Platform binary of lightningcss, same use.

exceptions.name: gsap
exceptions.why: Animation library the landing page ships (ScrollTrigger, SplitText); pinned, its license notice kept with the build.

exceptions.name: @gsap/react
exceptions.why: The useGSAP hook beside gsap, for React screens; pinned, its license notice kept with the build.

exceptions.name: minimatch
exceptions.why: Glob matcher pulled in by eslint; a permissive license not on the list, used only by the linter.
